articles.summary: Veteran marine insurance executive succeeds retiring President Walter Wynne Capacity Marine Corporation, a specialty marine insurance broker and part of Octave Specialty Group, Inc. (NYSE: OSG), today announced the appointment of Damon Vaughan as president, effective immediately. Vaughan succeeds Walter Wynne, who retired in May. Damon Vaughan, President of Capacity Marine Corporation Vaughan brings more than 40 years of marine insurance experience spanning underwriting, reinsurance, broking and program development in the U.S., London and Bermuda markets. He has extensive experience building and growing specialty marine programs, developing carrier and reinsurance relationships, and bringing new insurance products to market. Most recently, Vaughan was a founding partner of Theta Special Risk, an insurance consulting and advisory firm focused on bringing technology and more efficient digital processes to the insurance industry.
